title: 第21章 得阳燧得锐字第22章 照燃映
content_zh:
“住手住手！”
“我认输，我认输！”
“是你胜了，是你胜了，我以仙教起誓，你胜了！”
陆玄举剑欲斩，那明猿却直接大叫认输，甚至将手中灵兵扔在了地上。
它尚有目中火轮，但却不愿再斗了。
陆玄的焚髓剑煞乃是以燃命篆加持催动的，霸道绝伦，此前阻挡，已经消耗它大部分的炁力，催动幻术，更是炁力耗尽。
此刻仅得肉身和目中火轮之法。
但仅凭这些，它知晓是挡不住陆玄的剑煞的。
既然抵挡不住，索性直接认输，省得负伤。
最关键的是……陆玄的打法太拼了，竟然直接口吐精血，化为血雨，强行破去了自己的幻术。
这还是灵物之争？
仙教之外的生死之争，怕也没有这等惨烈吧。
“多谢猿士了。”
陆玄见状，微微一笑，挥剑一斩，将剑煞斩在了旁处。
这是焚髓而得的虎狼法门，他无法操控散去，只能挥之。
“轰！！”
而这一击，当即震的洞窟晃动，岩壁之中被斩出一道深深的剑痕，深邃不见底。
吓得明猿一激灵。
这要是斩在了它身上，这还了得。
“噗！”

而这一击之后，陆玄脸色顿时煞白，恍若金纸，嘴角更是不断渗血。
“哎呦！”
“没事吧，没事吧！”
“快止血，快止血！”
明猿顿时一惊，神色焦急，忍不住催促道。
它是真的没想到，区区一场灵物之争，能斗到如此地步。
阳燧枝固然是甲等上品灵物，但也不过是炼炁第一重开窍所用罢了，且未必能稳胜甲等中期，何至于此，何至于此啊？
“无妨，小伤尔！”
陆玄微微一笑，擦去嘴角鲜血，随后缓缓起身，来到洞中央，取出了一柄早就备好的寒纹小刀。
“可你在流血啊，血髓都要流干了！！”
那明猿比陆玄还着急。
content_en:
"Stop it!"
"I give up, I give up!"
"You won, you won, I swear by the Immortal Cult, you won!"
Lu Xuan raised his sword to kill, but Ming Yuan shouted to admit defeat and even threw the spirit weapon in his hand to the ground.
It still has eyes for the fire wheel, but it doesn't want to fight anymore.
Lu Xuan's Marrow-Burning Sword Demon was activated by the Life-Burning Seal. It was extremely domineering. Blocking it previously had consumed most of its energy, and activating the illusion even more exhausted its energy.
At this moment, I only have the method of the physical body and the fire wheel in my eyes.
But based on these alone, it knew that it could not stop Lu Xuan's sword.
Since you can't resist it, just admit defeat directly to avoid getting hurt.
The most important thing is... Lu Xuan's fighting style was too hard. He actually vomited blood from his mouth and turned it into a rain of blood, forcibly breaking his illusion.
Is this still a battle between spiritual beings?
The battle of life and death outside the Immortal Sect is probably not as brutal.
"Thank you Ape Shi."
Seeing this, Lu Xuan smiled slightly, swung his sword and slashed the sword demon aside.
This was the tiger-wolf method obtained by burning marrow. He couldn't control it and could only wave it away.
"Boom!!"
And this blow immediately shook the cave, and a deep sword mark was cut into the rock wall, which was bottomless.
Ming Yuan was so frightened that he trembled.
If this were to hit it, it wouldn't be a big deal.
"Poof!"
After this blow, Lu Xuan's face suddenly turned pale, like gold paper, and blood continued to ooze from the corners of his mouth.
"Ouch!"
"It's okay, it's okay!"
"Stop the bleeding, stop the bleeding!"
Ming Yuan was suddenly startled, looked anxious, and couldn't help but urge.
It really didn't expect that a mere battle between spiritual objects could reach such an extent.
Although the Yang Suizhi is a first-class high-grade spiritual object, it is only used for the first level of Qi refining, and it may not be able to win the second-level first-class spiritual object. Why is it so, why is it so?
"It doesn't matter, it's a minor injury!"
Lu Xuan smiled slightly, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, then slowly stood up, went to the center of the cave, and took out a cold pattern knife that had been prepared for a long time.
"But you are bleeding, your blood marrow is draining away!!"
Na Ming Yuan was even more anxious than Lu Xuan.
